title: Observations reuse timestamp identities
symptom: Automatic observations use timestamps and local numeric suffixes instead of random slug identities.
trigger: Run the same case repeatedly in one root and in two independent roots with identical starting records.
expected: Every attempt receives a distinct OBS slug plus 24 lowercase hex ID and an inherited artifact path.
actual: The direct test observed old-form ID tc-cli-0001-1793579540 and exited 101.
impact: Independent roots and identical repeated runs do not receive the approved collision-resistant observation identities.

notes.text: Added despite similar reports: The existing bug covers validation run allocation; this defect is observation and artifact allocation in cases and evidence.

status: open -> verified. Takeover rerun passed the original focused regression with an automatically allocated new-form observation and inherited artifact path. Original failed observation and artifact retained. Native acceptance and full-suite verification remain separate.
